title: Everyday readiness

pairs.key: An approved infant sleep surface should be firm and ___.
Birth to 5 months: rooting toward breast or bottle can signal what need?
Birth to 5 months: turning away and closing the mouth during a feed can signal what?
A baby 3 months or younger has a rectal temperature of 100.4°F / 38°C or higher. Call the pediatrician when?
Overwhelmed by crying? For a brief calming break, put baby on their back in an empty crib or on a couch? Answer crib or couch.

context: Memory practice, not medical advice or certification of hands-on care. Follow the baby’s clinician for individual needs. Karp is an optional soothing framework; Montessori is an educational approach. Safety guidance takes precedence. Sources checked 2026-11-02. Use a safety-approved crib, bassinet or play yard with a fitted sheet, no loose bedding or soft objects. Do not substitute a floor mattress or futon. Read cues together rather than treating one motion as proof. Crying can be a late hunger sign. Do not pressure the baby to finish a bottle; discuss feeding concerns with their clinician. Do not wait for additional symptoms or use soothing techniques instead of seeking care. This is an escalation reminder, not diagnosis or medication advice. A safe bassinet or play yard is also appropriate; the question contrasts two specific locations. Seek another adult’s help and return/check on baby once calm. Never shake.
